title: Jason Kelce Talks Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce Wedding Before Chiefs ‘MNF’ Victory: ‘The Ceremony Was Gorgeous’
summary: The former NFL player shouted out all the "awesome" people from all walks of life who attended his younger brother's July nuptials at MSG.
contentText:
Jason Kelce got the memo: what happened at MSG stays at MSG. But that didn’t stop the former NFL great for spilling a little on his brother Travis Kelce’s wedding to Taylor Swift this summer during ESPN’s Monday Night Countdown show on Monday (Sept. 14).

Before Travis and the Kansas City Chiefs demolished the Denver Broncos 31-10 on the first Monday Night Football matchup of the season, Jason Kelce pried the door open just a bit on what the vibe was like at the New York arena for the star-studded affair whose details have remained the best kept secret in show business.

“ So many awesome people , obviously, all walks of life,” said Jason, who was the best man at the July 3 affair. “The football world, celebrity world, singers from Nashville, actors, actresses, people that we grew up with in Cleveland Heights, a melting pot of individuals,” said Jason of the guest mix he described as “insane.”

Jason said the ceremony was “gorgeous,” saying the couple did an “incredible job” putting together the event that was officiated by actor/comedian Adam Sandler in what Kelce described as “in a very Adam Sandler, beautiful way.” ESPN’s Scott Van Pelt, who was also at the wedding, seconded that emotion, saying of Sandler, “yes, he did.”

“And then, from then on, it was a party. It was so good seeing everybody out there,” Jason said, giving out some extra love to “all of the people that sang” and “all the people dancing. It was a very fun evening.”

While we know for sure the couple got hitched — mostly because billboards outside MSG read “JUST&T MARRIED,” very few details about what went on inside have leaked so far, other than some of the names on the guest list , which included performers Paul McCartney and Stevie Nicks, as well as Ciara, Avril Lavigne, Tate McRae and Ice Spice. Among the guests who reportedly attended were: Jessica Alba, Elizabeth Banks, Stephen Colbert, Bradley Cooper, Tom Cruise —  who was seated next to Swift in a luxury box at Monday night’s Chiefs game — Lena Dunham, Jimmy Fallon, Tom Hanks, Mariska Hargitay, Liam Hemsworth, Conan O’Brien, Brad Pitt, Gracie Abrams, Jack Antonoff, Benson Boone and many more.

Even Travis has kept details sparse in the interviews he’s done since the wedding, including in a teaser clip of an ESPN interview with Chris Berman in which Kelce called the wedding the “ best night of my life .” He added, “Marrying Taylor was, you know, it was more than I could have ever dreamed it to be because of all the people that showed up … and the amount of, you know, love that was in the air.”

Travis talked a bit more about the special night on the recent season premiere of his New Heights podcast with Jason, where he said, “ Me and Taylor are so thankful to everybody that showed up . It was just so magical, man. Thank you to everyone at MSG that allowed us to do this. We wanted to do it somewhere where we could have a very intimate and genuine setting without a lot of distractions, we needed it to be a private feel.”
